User Story: As a new visitor I can create an account with name/email/password
Expected Behaviour: POST /register creates user + hashed password and logs in; redirects to onboarding
Edge Cases: Duplicate email rejected; weak/blank password rejected; email format validated

User Story: As a user I can log in and stay authenticated
Expected Behaviour: POST /login validates credentials and starts session; throttled on repeated failure

User Story: As a user I can request and complete a password reset
Expected Behaviour: Reset link emailed; token validates; password updated

User Story: As a logged-in user I can change/confirm my password
Expected Behaviour: PATCH password requires current password; confirm gate guards sensitive routes

User Story: As a user I verify my email via signed link
Expected Behaviour: Verification link marks email verified; unverified gated

User Story: As a new user I complete a profile wizard (name/birthdate/sex/units/height/weight/goal/tone/meals)
Expected Behaviour: POST /onboarding validates and builds Profile + body metric + macro targets; gates dashboard until done
Edge Cases: Imperial<->metric conversion; band-in-hand routes to device pairing; deep-intake seeds coach memory
Notes: DEF-001 fixed: height_cm now decimal(5,1) so imperial 71in->180.3cm persists

User Story: As a user I generate a dream-physique image during onboarding
Expected Behaviour: POST /onboarding/physique creates a physique goal from intake

User Story: As a user I see my daily health overview

Expected Behaviour: devices.apple-health.import stream-parses export.xml into recovery/sleep/body/workout tables; returns summary
Edge Cases: Happy: valid zip imports + body_metrics written | Permission: guest redirected to login | Invalid: missing file -> friendly error | Boundary: non-zip rejected with guidance | post_max_size overflow guarded

Expected Behaviour: devices.polar.connect redirects to Polar; callback exchanges code + records WearableConnection
Edge Cases: Happy: configured callback writes connection (POLAR/polar/connected) | Permission: guest redirected | Config: not-configured degrades with friendly msg | Error: cancelled/access_denied handled | Security: state mismatch rejected (CSRF)
Notes: Gap closed iteration 2; access-token persistence still a known scaffold TODO
